hooks.command: printf '%s\n' "Agent Plan is available through /agent-plan:start, status, checkpoint, restore, recover, accept and stop. Use only Claude built-in tools and native subagents for this workflow. You are the supervisor. Spawn one native coordinator per ticket. Each coordinator spawns its own workers. Read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/contract.md and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/task-record.md, then ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/workflows/supervisor.md when invoked. Native nesting requires Claude Code 2.1.219 or newer and spawn depth at least two. Look up peers in agent-plan/active.md under the user Claude config directory. Only the supervisor writes that log. Ticket notes live in agent-plan/tasks/, with repository identity in each brief. After resume or compaction of an Agent Plan supervisor session, read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/workflows/continuity.md and follow Restore before action using the exact session memory or snapshot and unambiguous session identity. Reload saved discussion and required task notes, then reconcile Git, coordinator ownership and hosted delivery before action. Never select another session by recency. Keep the same session; do not use /clear to refresh supervisor context. If no memory path or session identity is known, use /agent-plan:restore with a selected checkpoint; do not guess. Do not start or resume work merely because this plugin loaded."
